gaps.distinction: the judgment of nineteen compiling rule declarations
gaps.detail: TestEveryCompilingCensusRowIsDeclared refuses at the pinned ref: nineteen census.json rows compile and the binding corpus declares no family for them, so no owner column is emitted and every consumer of those families - reader and declarer alike - has no surface after the cut. Named rows: call/activation#call-activation, effect/callsite/body#effect-body, heap/formalfreeze#heap-formal-freeze, heap/publicationfreeze#heap-publication-freeze, placement/allocationbirth#placement-allocation-birth, placement/capture#placement-closure-capture, placement/containment#placement-containment, placement/formal#placement-formal, placement/freshbirth#placement-fresh-birth, placement/publicationescape#placement-publication-escape, placement/returnescape#placement-return-escape, placement/store#placement-storage, placement/suspension#placement-suspension, placement/suspension-evidence#placement-suspension-evidence, placement/transfer#placement-transfer, typestate#typestate-obligation, value/bodyresult#value-callresult-body, value/freshresult#value-callresult-freshresult, value/resultalias#value-callresult-resultalias. The whole Placement axis is inside this set and emits no binding at all.

gaps.distinction: the answer of an indexed raw read and the commit of an indexed raw write
gaps.detail: Four corpus families carry no judgment and are declared Pending: RawGetPackRoutes, RawSetPackRoutes, RawGetResult, RawSetCommit. domain/heap/index additionally holds no memberdefinition package and no generated relation owner - its route relations are hand-declared callbacks in schema_fragment.go, which the manifest deletes under S4-schema-fragments. The rule reads Heap, Value, Call and Pack columns by selection tag and no declared relation carries those tags.

gaps.distinction: every published query answer, attached observation and diagnostic row
gaps.detail: The eleven census2.json declarations compile in relcompile and have no binding corpus family, no emitted binding, and no law requiring one - census_law_test.go reads census.json alone. This is the plane the whole read side depends on: the query fragment consumers, the diagnostic collectors, the detached result projection and every observation admission answer from it. Rows: diagnostic/code-composed, diagnostic/code-declared, observation/branch-condition, observation/call-callee-set, observation/type-conformance, observation/type-reference-unresolved, observation/value-reference-unresolved, query/effect-exact, query/placement-summary, query/query-site, query/value-summary. Compounding it, no typed reader package exists on any axis at the pinned ref: Value, Heap, Pack, Call, Effect and Static carry emitted relbindgen.Column codecs, but nothing exposes a Read over a snapshot projection, so even a bound column has no consumer-facing surface. At the pinned ref no consumer read in this map is served by an emitted binding.

gaps.distinction: the joined static type fact at each Value coordinate
gaps.detail: domain/static/type_summary_result_codec.go declares SummaryResultFamily = "static-type-summary" and domain/static/type_summary_observation.go folds it from engine.OrderedCells[TypeFact], and analysis/result/project.go encodes it into a canonical result cell. The family appears in neither census plane: census.json holds only static/transfer and census2.json holds no static row. A live result family is declared nowhere.
